_comment: Scenario-staged ROLL_THE_LINE demo: a full-strength (120) player Infantry unit is ordered under the roll-the-line stance to attack a lone weak (15-man, low-morale) enemy at the front of a line of three. As each enemy in turn breaks and routs, the attacker automatically rolls onto the next-closest enemy still fighting -- no fresh order issued for the second or third target. Camera holds on the line so the sequential engagement reads clearly.

facing_flutter.reason: Tracked in #1764, a sub-degree facing sawtooth (about 0.25 degrees, every 2-4 ticks) while uid 3 marches up behind uid 1. Measured 2026-10-09, merge-base 1f4a77eb against fix commit 392571fd (whose roll_the_line transcript is identical to 20bf172b's). Under CI's dense delta (2-tick samples from the divergence tick 61), the merge-base reads uid 3 at 2, below the threshold of 3, and the fix reads 7. So at that sampling the merge-base passes and only the fix fails. Two measurements attribute the sawtooth itself to code older than the fix. With every tick from 61 to 540 sampled, the merge-base fails too: uid 3 at 6 and uid 2 at 4 (the fix: 13 and 9). And a temporary exact-facing print measured the same amplitude on both trees (merge-base ticks 220-249, fix ticks 154-176). Uid 3 never reflects its grid. It differs only because uid 1, which bakes its re-square's mirror at tick 62, now keeps its men on their flanks, so uid 3 marches behind a differently shaped block.
